ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low ratio of high-intensity pixels to low-intensity pixels; ventral surface is approximately 98% dark/black pigmentation (pixel values < 30) with less than 2% high-intensity white speckling.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Solid, contiguous black pigmentation across the entire visible ventral field. Sparse, high-contrast white micro-blobs (1-3 pixels in diameter) are localized in the lower-central region above the peduncle and scattered along the inferior margin of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped median notch with a calculated angle of approximately 52 degrees and a depth-to-width ratio of roughly 1:1.2 relative to the immediate lobe boundaries.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a broadly convex trajectory from the notch to the tips, with a distinct increase in curvature (convexity) at the distal 1/4 of both lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: A small cluster of roughly 12 high-intensity white pixel points is visible on the lower interior quadrant of the right lobe, consistent with focal scarring patterns.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent, deep irregular indentation/notch is visible on the trailing edge of the right lobe, located approximately midway between the central notch and the fluke tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Active water turbulence and spray obscuring the pixel data at the junction of the peduncle and the ventral fluke surface.
